known_limitations.detail: the shipped 5415 shell is an open sheet, not a solid: one boundary loop of 722 edges (deck edge plus the stem seam). Surface-integral displacement is therefore withheld: the displacement asserted on this case is the dataset/station-area one, cross-checked against the README particulars table (see reference), not an integral over this shell. Passing closed=True to compute_hydrostatics on this shell returns the signed tetrahedron sum of an open surface (negative here), which is not a volume; the previous 'relative_discrepancy' of 2.6 was measuring that artifact, not an integration error. Closing the sheet is not a one-liner: after welding, mesh_repair.boundary_loops refuses this boundary (a vertex is walked by two walks at the stem pinch), so a watertight repair needs the seam stitched first.
